hero.title: Recitations from the Sunnah

recitations.playHint: Tap a surah to open and play it.

friday.title: Friday
friday.subtitle: Recite on the day of Jumuʿah.

sleep.title: Before Sleep
sleep.subtitle: A nightly routine of protection, every night.

kahf.detail: Recite Surah Al-Kahf between Maghrib on Thursday and Maghrib on Friday for a light between the two Fridays.
kahf.source: Strongest as a statement of Abu Saʿid al-Khudri; graded sahih by al-Albani (Sahih al-Jamiʿ). [al-Hakim 2/399; al-Bayhaqi; al-Darimi 3407]. Scholars differ on whether it is directly from the Prophet ﷺ, but all act upon it.

mulk.detail: Surah Al-Mulk is the Protector (al-Maniʿah); it guards against the punishment of the grave.

sajdahMulk.detail: The Prophet ﷺ would not sleep until reciting both As-Sajdah and Al-Mulk.

baqarahLast.detail: The last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah suffice the one who recites them at night.

quls.detail: Recite the three Quls — Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas — three times, then blow into the palms and wipe over the body.

ayatAlKursiSleep.detail: Recite Ayat al-Kursi before sleep for protection until morning.

ayatAlKursiPrayer.detail: Recite Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer.

qulsMorningEvening.detail: Recite the three Quls — Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas — three times each, morning and evening.

hero.title: A luminous place to read, remember, and return.
hero.lead: PEACE2074 is a multilingual Quran and reflection space designed to feel calm, beautiful, and deeply usable—whether you open it for one ayah, one breath, or a longer journey.

spotlight.label: Designed for gentle focus
spotlight.title: Built to lower noise and raise presence.
spotlight.body: Every screen aims to feel clear, supportive, and spiritually grounded—from surah reading and verse sharing to bookmarks, offline listening, and daily reflection.

experience.label: calm experience across web and iOS

story.title: Faith tools can be powerful without being overwhelming.
story.body: PEACE2074 brings together Quran reading, remembrance, thoughtful exploration, and practical support in one place. The goal is simple: help you return to what matters with less friction and more beauty.
story.cardBody: Instead of scattered utilities and noisy interfaces, PEACE2074 gathers reading, recitation, Tasbeeh, Holy Names, reflections, and support into a single peaceful flow.

verse.label: Guiding spirit
verse.quote: Peace is not only something you search for. It is something you practice, page by page, prayer by prayer, return by return.

pillars.title: Three pillars shape the experience
pillars.lead: Each part of the app is meant to feel useful on a rushed day and beautiful on a quiet one.

read.title: Read with clarity
read.body: Explore the Quran with focused reading modes, verse sharing, bookmarks, and recitation that stays out of your way.

remember.title: Remember with presence
remember.body: Keep dhikr close through digital Tasbeeh, Holy Names, and gentle prompts that support consistency without pressure.

connect.title: Connect with support
connect.body: Find help through chat, contact flows, and thoughtful guidance when you need direction—not more noise.

journey.title: Move from curiosity to consistency
journey.lead: Whether you arrive searching, reflecting, or rebuilding a habit, PEACE2074 meets you where you are.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Start with a surah, a verse, or a question and let the app make the next step obvious.

reflect.title: Reflect
reflect.body: Use recitation, translations, reminders, and spiritual tools to stay with the meaning a little longer.

return.title: Return
return.body: Come back anytime to your bookmarks, routines, and peaceful momentum—no steep re-entry required.

promise.title: Beautiful, useful, and respectful by default
promise.body: The experience is shaped around focus, multilingual access, and a calm visual rhythm that respects both reflection and routine.
promise.two: Localization with RTL support for Arabic and Hebrew
promise.three: Offline recitation and supportive tools across web and iOS

build.title: Open code, iOS polish, and SEO-ready foundations
build.lead: PEACE2074 shares its public repository, ships a calm iOS experience through Capacitor, and keeps key pages discoverable with route-aware SEO and structured data.

repo.title: Follow the project in real time
repo.body: The codebase is public on GitHub, and the same foundation powers the web experience and the iOS app with transparent issues, contributor history, and workflow runs.

analytics.title: Measured with consent, not guesswork
analytics.body: Analytics are wired to respect consent, track product health, and pair with canonical URLs, meta tags, and structured data so the experience stays measurable and discoverable.
analytics.pointConsent: Consent settings control analytics collection before events are sent.
analytics.pointGa4: GA4 and native Firebase analytics capture journeys like page views, bookmarks, and key product interactions.
analytics.pointReader: Reader analytics summarize surah progress and reading patterns for signed-in users.
analytics.pointSeo: Route metadata, canonical URLs, Open Graph tags, and structured data help key pages stay search-friendly.

cta.title: Stay as long as you need.
cta.body: Open the Quran, explore the Holy Names, or reach out if you want help shaping the journey.

manifesto.quote: Here's to the crazy ones. The misfits. The rebels. The troublemakers. The round pegs in the square holes. The ones who see things differently. They're not fond of rules. And they have no respect for the status quo. You can quote them, disagree with them, glorify or vilify them. About the only thing you can't do is ignore them. Because they change things. They push the human race forward. And while some may see them as the crazy ones, we see genius. Because the people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world, are the ones who do.

miracles.numericExamplesTitle: Examples of numerical miracles in the Qur'an
miracles.oppositeWordsDesc: The numbers of some opposite words are equal, such as "the world" and "the hereafter" (115 times each), "angels" and "devils" (88 times each), and "light" and "darkness" (24 times each).
miracles.wordRelations: Relationships between the numbers of words, letters, verses, and surahs
miracles.wordRelationsDesc: The focus is on numbers, such as the number of chapters in the Qur'an being 114.
miracles.conceptRelationsDesc: Relating the number of times certain words are repeated to other numbers, such as the word "month" being repeated 12 times (the number of months in a year).
miracles.letterCounts: Number of letters in the verses
miracles.letterCountsDesc: It is worth noting that the number of letters in some verses corresponds to a specific number, such as the number of letters from the beginning of a particular verse to its end being the same number mentioned in the verse itself.

privacy_intro: Your privacy is important to us. This page explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website.
basic_account_info: Basic account information (such as email address) if you register or log in.
usage_data: Usage data and cookies to improve your experience.
provide_services: To provide and maintain our services.
improve_experience: To improve and personalize your experience.
communicate_updates: To communicate with you about updates or support.
prayer_times_purpose: To calculate accurate prayer times based on your location and notify you when it is time to pray.
cookies_text: We use cookies to remember your preferences and enhance your experience. You can accept or decline cookies using the banner at the bottom of the site.
location_services_text: On iPhone and iPad, the app may request access to your device's location in order to calculate accurate Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for your area. Location data is used only on-device to compute prayer times — it is never transmitted to our servers, stored, or shared with third parties. You can deny or revoke location permission at any time in your device Settings; the app will then fall back to a default location (Jerusalem). The Apple TV app does not use location services.
push_notifications_text: The app may send you push notifications to alert you when a prayer time begins, so the Adhan (call to prayer) can play on time. Notifications are sent only if you explicitly grant permission. You can disable them at any time from your device Settings or from within the app.
data_security_text: We take reasonable measures to protect your data, but no system is 100% secure.
apple_tv_text: The PEACE2074 app is available on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV. The Apple TV app does not use the microphone, camera, location services, or push notifications. Session authentication uses secure HTTP-only cookies — no personal data is stored locally on the device. If you use iCloud, your device handles iCloud sync independently of our servers.
contact_text: If you have questions about our privacy policy, please contact us.
terms_intro: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before using our website.
acceptance_of_terms_text: By accessing or using our website, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our site.
use_of_site_1: You must use the site in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
use_of_site_2: You may not use the site for any unlawful or prohibited purpose.
terms_location_text: By enabling prayer time notifications you consent to the app accessing your device location solely to calculate prayer times on-device. This data is never stored or shared. You may revoke location access or notification permission at any time in your device Settings.
intellectual_property_text: All content on this site is the property of the site owner or its licensors and is protected by copyright laws.
limitation_of_liability_text: We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the site.
changes_to_terms_text: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the site means you accept the new terms.
